Title: Source Link Configuration Current State
Content: Source-link configuration lives under MemorySmith:SourceLinks and is visible from the admin Configuration tab. MaxReadBytes caps file content returned through source bundle/read paths. AllowOpenWithDefaultApp controls whether approved local file links may be opened through the operating system default application. AllowedFileRootVariables is a one-per-line list of variable names, such as MemorySmithRepo, whose resolved paths are allowed roots. AllowedFileRoots is a one-per-line list of explicit filesystem roots. VarResolver blocks reads and default-app opens outside the configured roots, reports missing variables and invalid line ranges as diagnostics, and keeps source-link content bounded for chat/MCP use.
